collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager turns a fish slowly over glowing coals.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) turns a fish slowly over glowing coals. The smell draws several hungry neighbors closer.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) turns a fish slowly over glowing coals. A gull lands nearby, watching with great patience.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) turns a fish slowly over glowing coals. (name1) shares the first piece with whoever happens to be closest.

e2__fx.name: Ending 2
e2__fx.text: (name1) turns a fish slowly over glowing coals. The skin crisps perfectly, and (name1) is very pleased.
